name: Futako-Tamagawa
tagline: Shibuya in 19 minutes and Shinjuku in 29 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Setagaya City, where Tokyu run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 43 minutes to Otemachi, 29 minutes to Shinjuku, 19 minutes to Shibuya and 36 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 13.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 11.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 13.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 7.8 m to 19 m, a difference of 11.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 3 to 5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 5 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 5 to 10 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is about average for the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 10 clinics and 9 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 日産厚生会 玉川病院, about 17 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is グランダ岡本里安邸, about 19 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line run through it. Tokyu Oimachi Line also call here. Both lines are run by Tokyu, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line runs at 138% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 池尻大橋→渋谷, which this station is not on. Tokyu Oimachi Line runs at 118%. Its busiest stretch is 九品仏→自由が丘, which this station is likewise not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Kaminoge is ahead on quiet, but Futako-Tamagawa is ahead on the number of lines and the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Futako-Tamagawa in a straight line. Kaminoge has only the Tokyu Oimachi Line, so Futako-Tamagawa is the better connected. To Shinjuku, for instance, Kaminoge takes 7 minutes longer. On safety, though, Kaminoge comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Yoga is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet, but Futako-Tamagawa is ahead on the number of lines and the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: About 2 km from Futako-Tamagawa in a straight line. Yoga has only the Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line, so Futako-Tamagawa is the better connected. To Shinagawa, for instance, Yoga takes 5 minutes longer. A one-room flat also costs about ¥6,000 more at Yoga. On safety, though, Yoga comes out ahead.
